```{=html}
<section class="privacy-section">
  <div class="ad-page-container">
    <div class="page-section u-mb-3">
      <h1 class="section-heading">Privacy Policy</h1>
      <p class="page-subtitle">What this site stores, what it loads from elsewhere, and what it never collects</p>
    </div>

    <div class="privacy-content">
      <p>
        AffineDrift does not run a server-side analytics platform, does not use tracking cookies,
        and does not sell or share visitor data. This page describes exactly what is stored in
        your browser, what third-party resources the site loads, and what analytics exist today.
      </p>

      <div class="site-card u-mb-3">
        <h2 class="u-mt-0">Local Storage (Usage Metrics)</h2>
        <p>
          <code>js/metrics.js</code> keeps a small usage-statistics widget entirely in your
          browser's <code>localStorage</code> and <code>sessionStorage</code>. It records page
          views, bibliography searches, bibliography entry clicks, and concept-tag clicks — all
          keyed to your browser only, under the key <code>affinedrift_metrics</code>. None of
          this data leaves your device: it is never transmitted to AffineDrift's servers or to
          any third party, and there is no way for the site operator to read it. You can clear it
          at any time with the "Clear data" button on the metrics widget, or by clearing your
          browser's site data for AffineDrift.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="site-card u-mb-3">
        <h2 class="u-mt-0">Service Worker (Offline Support)</h2>
        <p>
          <code>service-worker.js</code> caches static assets (pages, styles, and scripts) in
          your browser's Cache Storage so the site loads faster and remains usable offline. The
          service worker only fetches and stores public site content that your browser already
          requested; it does not collect, transmit, or report any personal or usage data. You can
          remove the cached data at any time by clearing your browser's site data for AffineDrift.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="site-card u-mb-3">
        <h2 class="u-mt-0">Third-Party Embeds</h2>
        <p>
          Some pages load resources from third-party domains, each governed by that provider's
          own privacy policy:
        </p>
        <ul>
          <li><strong>YouTube</strong> — video embeds on the
            <a href="../resources/resources-videos.html">Resources: Videos</a> page load
            player frames from <code>youtube.com</code>. YouTube may set its own cookies and
            collect data per its privacy policy once a video is played.</li>
          <li><strong>jsDelivr</strong> — the MathJax library used to render mathematical
            notation is loaded from the <code>cdn.jsdelivr.net</code> CDN.</li>
        </ul>
        <p>
          Fonts are self-hosted: the heading typeface is served from AffineDrift itself, so no
          third-party font host is contacted.
        </p>
        <p>
          The site's Content Security Policy limits which external domains a page is allowed to
          load resources from or embed frames from at all.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="site-card u-mb-3">
        <h2 class="u-mt-0">Analytics</h2>
        <p>
          AffineDrift does not run third-party analytics: there is no Google Analytics, no
          tracking pixel, and no cross-site tracking cookie anywhere on the site. The only
          "analytics" present today is the local-only usage widget described above, which never
          reaches AffineDrift or any third party. Per the site's reader-analytics decision (D6),
          any future site-wide analytics will be privacy-preserving, cookieless, and self-hosted —
          for example, aggregate page-view counts with no per-visitor identifiers — and this page
          will be updated before any such change takes effect.
        </p>
      </div>

      <p class="page-note">
        <strong>Questions.</strong> For questions about this policy, use the
        <a href="contact.html">Contact</a> page.
      </p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
